04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe Tol palette, bee-swarm + box-plot combo, leader-line callouts — but the subtitle text collides with the P25/P50 percentile labels and the top-earner callout for Sam Q. is clipped at the right edge.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale and dot-position encoding are honest for income data, percentiles and box-plot stats are fully data-driven, but the x-domain is hardcoded [14000,550000] instead of derived via d3.extent, breaking scaling robustness, and the swarm .data() join has no key function.
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: No brush/zoom/transition interactions exist so most stress-test traps are N/A; the only minor issue is tooltip pointermove calling offsetWidth (forced layout reflow) on every mousemove without throttling, but it is trivially cheap and the use of Pointer Events API correctly unifies mouse and touch.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout with a 4-color colorblind-safe palette, pre-computed (non-animating) swarm, and a marginal box plot that reads as one conceptual unit — well-managed complexity, though the dense center makes per-category separation harder and the 5 callout labels cluster tightly at the right tail.
